g.text: Residue of chain P, numbered as in the structure file
An interface has no centre. The residues of chain P that touch
chain A stand in a column, as boxes, in the order of the
sequence; a dotted line stands for residues in between that do
not; those of chain A around it. A line is a pair of residues, at the
shortest of its contacts of one kind.
All 9 residues of chain P at the interface are shown, with 29
